title: Starkscanner
tagline: Transaction visulizer for wallet addresses, transactions and contracts
description: Using D3.js, we create visualizations where wallets, transactions, and contracts are represented as nodes. This approach allows us to help users easily explore and understand complex relationships and interactions within the blockchain. Our visualization techniques make it intuitive for users to trace transactions between wallets, identify key contracts, and comprehend the overall network structure. By representing each element as a node and linking them based on their interactions, we provide a clear and insightful graphical representation that enhances the user's ability to analyze blockchain data effectively. This way, users can quickly identify patterns, anomalies, and significant events within the blockchain ecosystem.
how_its_made: We employ D3.js and React in our development stack to construct the frontend, leveraging their powerful capabilities for creating dynamic and interactive user interfaces. We rely on Node.js for the backend, which provides a robust and scalable environment for building and running server-side applications. Our data querying process involves interfacing with Token Flow to retrieve comprehensive transaction details. Additionally, we utilize the Voyager API to gather more extensive information related to transactions, wallets, and contrast, ensuring a holistic and detailed data perspective. This integrated approach enables us to deliver a seamless and informative user experience by combining cutting-edge frontend technologies with a reliable and efficient backend infrastructure.
